title: Input-Rule Congruence
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with state set $S$, let $q\in\mathrm{Option}(S)$ be a state or the halting marker, and let $\rho$ consist of an optional Boolean input symbol and one optional Boolean symbol for each work tape. For an integer offset $d$ and functions $f,g:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ that agree at every integer, the input-head update rule evaluated using $f$ equals the same rule evaluated using $g$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Boolean Turing machine M
A read tuple ρ of an optional input symbol and optional symbols on each work tape
Functions f and g from integers to optional Boolean symbols
Pointwise equality f(e)=g(e) for every integer e
